question: is there free food anywhere today
answer:
Yes. The We Care Program’s satellite pantries offer free grab-and-go food, including microwave soups and meals, granola and/or breakfast bars, and protein shakes. On Thursday, the listed locations with hours include the Peter P. Mercer Learning Commons (7:45 a.m.–12:00 a.m.), the Women’s Center in C-220 (10:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.), and the Multicultural Center in D-214 (11:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m.). The Dean of Students Office pantry in C-212 and EOF Office pantry in D-101 list Monday–Friday hours of 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; the Center for Student Success pantry in D-207 and First Generation Student Center pantry in D-210 list the same hours. Other satellite pantry locations are outside Counseling Services in D-216, in the Black Student Union (SC-277), and TAS Mathematics and Science Tutoring Center (G-131); no hours are listed for those locations. [3]
The ASB 130 Food Pantry lists Friday 2 p.m.–3 p.m. hours, so those listed hours are not today. Email wecare@ramapo.edu for access outside those hours or questions. [4]
You can also sign up through the Archway form (https://cglink.me/2fF/s60077), then select Forms and sign up for the week you want produce; the program offers a free bag of fresh fruits and vegetables each week. [5]
Today’s calendar also lists a free-admission service opportunity at the Center for Food Action, Thu, Oct 22, 2026 11:15 AM to 2:30 PM, Saddle Brook, NJ, hosted by the Civic and Community Engagement Center; the listing does not say food is provided. [1] Spooky Movie Night is Thu, Oct 22, 2026 8 PM to 9:30 PM at Laurel Movie Theater, hosted by College Park Apartments; its ticket is FREE, but the listing does not say food is provided. [2]
The Civic and Community Engagement Center (SC-213) can help: ccec@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7586. [3][4][5]

question: i'm a business major and dont live on campus, which club should i join to actually meet people
